players.product: GLM foundation models (GLM-5.3, GLM-5.3-Flash) served through the z.ai open platform / API (GLM MaaS), GLM Coding Plan subscriptions and on-premise deployment

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB724.3 million, up 131.9%; cloud-based deployment (open platform and API) RMB190.4 million (+292.6%, 26.3% of revenue) and on-premise deployment RMB534.0 million (+102.3%); by product line enterprise-level general-purpose large models RMB365.7 million (+70.5%), enterprise-level agents RMB165.7 million (+248.8%). Gross margin 41.0% (56.3%) as the cloud share rose; cloud-based gross margin improved to 18.9% (3.3%) on inference efficiency, scale and price increases while on-premise margin fell to 48.8% (66.0%) on heavier delivery resources. R&D expenses RMB3,180.4 million (+44.9%), mainly staff and computing service fees paid to third-party computing power suppliers; loss for the year RMB4,718.2 million; adjusted net loss RMB3,181,972 thousand. Capex fell to RMB74.7 million (RMB462.3 million) because compute was procured mainly as a service, supplemented by partial equipment leasing, instead of leased equipment; cash and cash equivalents RMB2,259.1 million at year-end.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue RMB724.3 million (+131.9%); cloud-based RMB190.4 million (+292.6%); R&D RMB3,180.4 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Demand, pricing and compute (annual report, management): the GLM Coding Plan reached over 242,000 paying developers, and the company raised Coding Plan prices by 30% and eliminated first-purchase discounts in February 2026; the BigModel.cn MaaS platform passed 4 million registered users as of March 2026 and, despite an 83% increase in API call pricing versus the end of 2025, the company says demand still outstrips supply ('computing power panic'); the Claw Plan launched in March 2026 passed 400,000 subscribers within 20 days. Management says a computing power shortage has outstripped supply since February 2026 and it will keep increasing investment, particularly in 'Day 0' adaptation of domestic chips and software-hardware optimization; it says GLM-5 was integrated within 24 hours of release by leading companies such as ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent, 9 of the top 10 Chinese internet companies have integrated GLM, and its services reach 218 countries and regions and over 8,000 institutional clients.
quarterly_data.figure: Coding Plan price +30%; API pricing +83%; over 242,000 paying developers

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhipu AI annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Technology (annual report): GLM-5 domestic-chip adaptation has entered software-hardware co-design, with customised fused kernels (Lightning Indexer, FlashComm) that the company says give GLM models inference efficiency on domestic chips comparable to top international chips; a dynamic sparse attention mechanism cut deployment costs by 50% with no performance loss; the Slime asynchronous reinforcement-learning framework (Prefill-Decode separation) trained the model on over 10,000 real software engineering environments and supported GLM-5-Turbo, which the company calls the first OpenClaw foundation model.
